title: Hands-free reading, any page
caption: Start with Alt+Shift+S or the popup and the page scrolls smoothly, with a speed bar and time left in the corner.

title: Controls right on the page
caption: Pause, slow down or speed up from the floating bar, or just press + and - while you read.

title: Finish the page right on time
caption: Say how many minutes you have and it picks the speed. Each site also remembers its own pace.

title: Space stays yours until you start
caption: Space only pauses and resumes once the scroller runs, so videos, games and page-down keep working.

title: Looks right in dark mode
caption: The popup follows your system theme, so it never glares at night.
